rankings_format: Monthly PDF (bilingual title 'RATINGS AS OF <MONTH> <YEAR> / CLASIFICACIONES DEL MES DE ...'), plus WordPress HTML champions/ratings and per-division pages. Could NOT verify page structure directly: wbcboxing.com returned HTTP 403 to our fetcher for both the HTML page and a PDF; all WBC facts here come from search-engine result titles/snippets.
divisions_seen: not verified (403). WBC recognises 17-18 men's divisions historically; unconfirmed from source.
ranks_per_division: WBC's own July 2026 release (via search snippet) describes ratings that 'highlight the top 40 fighters in each division' - unverified against the PDF
publication_date_label: PDF title per search index: 'RATINGS AS OF MARCH 2026 / CLASIFICACIONES DEL MES DE ...', 'ratings as ofjune 2026 / clasificaciones del mes de junio'. Female: 'RATINGS AS FEBRUARY - 2026'. Latest PDF seen in index: June 2026 (male); July 2026 announced by press release dated 2026-07-09.
title_classifications_note: Terms taken from wbcboxing.com search snippets (Franchise Champion article, Status by Division, female ratings PDF listing 'Champion, Interim, Champion in Recess, and Silver'). 'Diamond' and 'Eternal' NOT observed in this pass; do not assume.
mandatory_designation: Published via prose 'WBC Status by Division <Month Year>' posts and convention releases (e.g. 'WBC Ratings and Mandatories at Hamburg Convention'); interim champions 'obligated to fulfill two mandatory defenses' per snippet. Not a structured field.
historical_snapshots: Monthly PDFs discoverable at /mailing/<year>/ back to at least March 2025 in search index; older years exist in other paths (not enumerated). No archive index page verified.
wayback_note: CDX shows captures of /en/championsratings/ from 2019-04-12. PDF directory captures not confirmed (Internet Archive rate-limited/temporarily offline during check).
robots: User-agent: * / Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference / Allow: / ... then explicit 'Disallow: /' for Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider, CCBot, ClaudeBot, CloudflareBrowserRenderingCrawler, Google-Extended, GPTBot, meta-externalagent
terms: No website terms-of-use page found via search; site returned 403 so footer could not be read. Robots Content-Signal declares ai-train=no, use=reference.
identity_keys: none observed (PDF name + country text only; could not inspect)
notes: Access actively blocked for our fetcher (403) and robots Content-Signal limits use to 'reference'. Do not bypass with spoofed user agents. Manual human reading of the monthly PDF as reference is the realistic path; any automated ingest needs owner review and ideally WBC permission. PDF filenames are irregular (trailing underscores/spaces), so URL guessing is brittle.

rankings_format: Server-rendered HTML (WordPress) per division on one page, plus 'Download WBA Rankings' PDF. 'Search Rankings' month selector.
publication_date_label: 'World Boxing Association Ranking as of AUGUST 2026' and 'August 31st, 2026' (seen 2026-09-13)
title_classifications_note: Ranking page uses uppercase 'WBA SUPER CHAMPION'/'WBA WORLD CHAMPION'/'WBA INTERIM CHAMPION'; champions page uses 'WBA Super World', 'WBA World', 'Interim WBA', 'WBA Gold', 'Champion in recess'. Regional suffixes in lists: GOLD, INT (International), C/A (Continental Americas), NABA, LAC, PANAF, WBAO, CON, I/C, INTER, OC. Also lists other bodies' champions inline (e.g. 'WBO CHAMPION').
mandatory_designation: No mandatory marker in the ranking list; separate 'WBA Mandatory Fights' page (returned HTTP 500 at time of check).
historical_snapshots: Yes. Rankings page 'Search Rankings' dropdown spans 2026 back to 2000 by month; PDFs at /wba-ranking-pdf/<year>/... and older /wp-content/uploads/rankings/<year>-<month>.pdf (2018, 2019 confirmed).
terms: Footer: 'Copyright © 1998 - 2026 The World Boxing Association'. Legal page: 'The information contained in the WBA website is provided for informational purposes only', content 'not binding in any way', 'may not reflect the most current developments and may contain editing errors'; users should 'request official certification from the competent body'. No explicit scraping clause found on that page. Also a 'Confidentiality Clause' under regulations (not read).
recommended_state_caveat: Technically the best source; still copyright-reserved and self-described as non-binding, so owner should confirm before publishing verbatim lists.
notes: Best structured official source: server HTML, stable fighter IDs, monthly archive to 2000, PDF as cross-check. Parse both ranking page and champions page since label vocabularies differ. Rankings are 'as of' month-end but published days later.

rankings_format: JS-rendered: HTML page is an empty shell; jQuery (theme ratings-filter.js) calls a public WordPress REST endpoint /wp-json/ratings/v1/filter returning JSON. Ratings field is a semicolon-delimited string 'Name,Country (ISO3)[,State];'. 'Rating PDF' button is a POST form (not tested).
divisions_seen: 18 weight slugs in selector (heavyweight..jr-mini-flyweight); script excludes jr-mini-flyweight for IBF men -> 17 men's; IBF female excludes heavyweight and cruiserweight
ranks_per_division: 15 (script renders i<=14; empty slot rendered as 'NOT RATED' - e.g. Heavyweight Aug 2026 #2 is empty)
publication_date_label: Rendered as 'Ratings posted on 09/08/2026. Based on results from 08/1/2026 to 08/31/2026.' JSON: rating_month '20260831', post_date '09/08/2026', title 'IBF: HEAVYWEIGHT (OVER 200LBS) – 08/2026'
title_classifications_note: JSON fields: champ ('Name,Country,;TitleWon;Mandatory;Defended'), interim_champ, plus wba/wbc/wbo champion names for cross-reference. Champion card shows 'Title won', 'Mandatory', 'Defended' dates. No super/regular tiers.
mandatory_designation: Champion 'Mandatory' due date field in champ string (rendered under champion as 'Mandatory <date>'). IBF commonly leaves #1/#2 as 'NOT RATED' when no eligible contender (observed: Heavyweight #2 empty). Mandatory challenger names are not explicitly flagged in the list.
historical_snapshots: Yes. Same JSON endpoint with ppp=-1 returned 246 monthly Heavyweight snapshots from rating_month 20051201 (post 12/01/2005) to 20260831 (post 09/08/2026).
wayback_note: CDX has captures of /ratings/ (latest 2026-08-09) but page is a JS shell so captures contain little data; the JSON endpoint is the archive.
robots: Crawl-delay: 10 / Yoast block 'User-agent: * Disallow:' (allow all) / Disallow: /thank-you/, /location/, /author/, /weight-class/, /promoter/ / Sitemap: https://www.ibf-usba-boxing.com/sitemap_index.xml. /wp-json/ not disallowed.
terms: Footer: '2026 International Boxing Federation. All Rights Reserved.' 'Terms of Use' footer link points to privacy policy, which contains no terms on reuse/automation.
identity_keys: none (name + country ISO3 + USBA state only; no fighter IDs, no profile links on champions page)
recommended_state_caveat: Endpoint is undocumented (site-internal); honour Crawl-delay 10, cache monthly, owner to confirm. Name-only identity needs our own matching.
notes: Richest machine-readable history of the four (20+ years monthly JSON, with champion won/mandatory/defended dates). Names contain typos in source; also IBF Intercontinental, USBA and ~25 regional org slugs available. Champion page listed Filip Hrgovic heavyweight title won 08/29/2026.

urls.rankings_search: https://wboboxing.com/rankings/ (POST form: req_ORG, req_year 2000-current, req_month, req_category, req_genre M/F)

rankings_format: Current ratings: text-based PDF generated on request (Producer 'dompdf 2.0.3 + CPDF', CreationDate = fetch time) - text extractable with pypdf. Rankings page is a POST search form (not submitted). Champions pages are HTML.
divisions_seen: 17 men's in PDF (HEAVYWEIGHT, JR. HEAVYWEIGHT, LT. HEAVYWEIGHT, SUP. MIDDLEWEIGHT, MIDDLEWEIGHT, JR. MIDDLEWEIGHT, WELTERWEIGHT, JR. WELTERWEIGHT, LIGHTWEIGHT, JR. LIGHTWEIGHT, FEATHERWEIGHT, JR. FEATHERWEIGHT, BANTAMWEIGHT, JR. BANTAMWEIGHT, FLYWEIGHT, JR. FLYWEIGHT, MINI-FLYWEIGHT); 17 female champion divisions incl. ATOM
ranks_per_division: 15, plus unnumbered '**' lines (regional/youth titleholders listed below the top 15)
publication_date_label: 'WBO MALE WORLD RATINGS / As of August 28, 2026' (4-page PDF, fetched 2026-09-13)
title_classifications_note: PDF lists WBO champion under 'CHAMPIONS' with WBA/IBF/WBC holders beside it, interim as 'CALLUM SMITH (Interim) (GBR)'. Regional titles appended to ranked names: (Int-Cont), (WBO Global), (WBO Europe), (Latino), (NABO), (Asia-Pacific), (WBO Oriental), (WBO Africa), (WBO Youth), (International). 'Super Champion' variants came from the male champions page summary and should be re-verified before modelling.
mandatory_designation: Not marked in the PDF. 'Mandatory Challenger Request' is an official form; mandatory orders appear in 'Official Rulings' documents and monthly 'Ranking Explanations' prose.
historical_snapshots: Rankings search form offers years 2000-current by month (via POST; not tested). Some archived PDFs under /wp-content/uploads/<yyyy>/<mm>/ (Feb 2024 confirmed). Ranking Explanations archive visible Sept 2025 - July 2026.
wayback_note: CDX captures of /rankings/ from 2012-04-05; Feb 2024 PDF captured 2025-08-14. Report URL captures not checked.
terms: Footer: 'Privacy Policy / Cookie Policy | World Boxing Organization. All Rights Reserved.' No terms-of-use page linked. Footer shows BoxRec logo captioned 'The Official Record Keeper'.
identity_keys: none in PDF (NAME (ISO3)); WBO endorses BoxRec as official record keeper - BoxRec is BLOCKED for us, do not use
recommended_state_caveat: Current PDF is permissive to fetch and parse; history requires POSTing a search form, and PDF text layout needs a fragile parser. Candidate for approved_ingest of current monthly PDF after owner review.
notes: PDF spelling errors exist in source (e.g. 'DANIEL BUBOIS'), so name matching must be fuzzy with human review. Champion block ordering in extracted text: other-body champions, then 'CHAMPIONS', then WBO champion line.

rankings_format: Server-rendered HTML tables (WordPress): Name | Record | Nationality | Last Week; champion marked with crown icon / '***' in last-week column.
publication_date_label: Home page 'Latest Update' dates '7 September 2026' (men) and '9 September 2026' (women); not repeated on the men's rankings table itself
historical_snapshots: Rankings archive HTML visible back to 13 December 2021 (earlier may exist); successions pages give lineal champion history.
terms: Footer 'Copyright © TBRB 2012-2026'. No terms-of-use or reproduction/attribution policy found; charter page fetch returned only intro quotes.
identity_keys: none (name + record + nationality; no fighter links)
recommended_state_caveat: Easy to parse, but copyright-reserved with no stated licence; use as internal comparator only unless permission obtained.
notes: Useful independent check on who the 'real' divisional champion is and for lineal successions. Records shown are likely BoxRec-derived; do not treat as a record source.
